items.text: Ladd McConkey now has been ruled out with a concussion.
items.why: Head injury mid-game vs KC; ruled out concussion.
items.implication: Chargers WR depth hit; Johnston and others elevated rest of game and potentially next.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Quentin Johnston and remaining LAC receivers.

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.implication: BUF WR targets redistribute; Palmer active as option.
items.opportunity: Increased targets for other Bills WRs/TEs in two-minute/red zone.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings practice squad Tuesday).
items.why: Ankle injury; only one limited practice this week; pregame workout determined out.
items.implication: Browns RB depth thinned to McLaughlin and Estime; low-upside committee or committee backfield.
items.opportunity: Carries and snaps open for McLaughlin/Estime in CLE backfield vs BAL.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers elevated; Indy passing game without primary TE option.
items.opportunity: TE targets/routes to other Colts options or streamers vs TEN.

items.text: Sunday #FantasyFootball injuries we're watching: * Davante Adams (leg) * Ladd McConkey (concussion) * Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned to game) * Romeo Doubs (shoulder) * Rashod Bateman (shoulder) * Darnell Mooney (neck)
items.why: Post/in-game updates for remaining or next-week impact.
items.implication: Adams leg and McConkey concussion key for ROS/next; Kincaid returned.
items.opportunity: If Adams limited next, boost other LAR WRs; McConkey out opens LAC.

items.text: Actives today include: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Quinshon Judkins, Tyler Warren.
items.why: Official actives confirmed after expected reports.
items.implication: Full go for key fantasy assets in early games.
items.opportunity: Normal snap/route/target shares for Olave/Kamara; Williams starting.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active.
items.why: Confirmed active opposite Warren inactive in TEN-IND.

items.text: Both officially active. (TreVeyon Henderson and AJ Brown likely then confirmed).
items.implication: NE near full health with Brown returning.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets for AJ Brown; Henderson RB role intact.

items.text: Whoa! Popped up on injury report but still surprising. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among my fave streamer TE's ...
items.why: Warren inactive creates TE streaming need.
items.opportunity: TE targets available in those offenses.

items.text: I have Cam Skattebo at RB 28, Najee Harris at RB 33 ... My guess is split between Cam & Najee. Harris has better shot than DK vs TB at a TD today. I'd go Najee.
items.why: Post-rotation/fumble concerns; still startable but riskier flex.
items.implication: Prefer Najee in some spots over other options; Skattebo still start but lower.
items.opportunity: Najee TD upside in run-friendly script vs NO.

items.text: #Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is out indefinitely.
items.implication: PHI QB situation long-term; impacts Hurts stacks and PHI offense.
items.opportunity: Backup QB opportunity; possible role shifts for PHI skill players.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Expectation of larger Najee Harris role with Skattebo downgraded but still mixed.
items.why: Poor YOE + 4 fumbles; sources indicate rotation change favoring Najee.
items.opportunity: Najee Harris larger share of carries/snaps; all 4 Giants RBs active.

items.text: Summary of weekend #FantasyFootball reports: GAME-TIME DECISION * Quinshon Judkins * Tyler Warren * Mike Evans, Christian Kirk EXPECTED TO PLAY * Caleb Williams * Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara * AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson * DK Metcalf * Pat Freiermuth * Kenyon Sadiq NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY * Deebo Samuel * Jacory Croskey-Merritt * Sean Tucker ACTIVATED * Jaydon Blue
items.why: Weekend reports compilation for Sunday decisions.
items.implication: Core tracking for early GTD resolutions and expected plays.
items.opportunity: Monitor for beneficiary snaps if GTD go out; reverse if in.

items.text: Judkins out, Tyler Warren out, Cam or Najee in NY? You have questions... #FFHappyHour covering Judkins/Warren/Cam-Najee.
items.why: Live Happy Hour addressing key Sunday status questions.
items.implication: Real-time start/sit guidance on affected players.

items.text: With Huntley back under center expect another run heavy approach for BAL against CLE; all in on Andy Reid at home off a bye - Walker should be fresh & ready to rock... and there may be no hotter RB in the NFL these days than Jaylen Warren.
items.why: Run-heavy scripts expected BAL and KC home off bye.
items.implication: Elevate Walker and Jaylen Warren in start/sit.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone shares in positive scripts.

items.text: No news yet on status of DJ Moore, Josh Palmer, Tyjae Spears. Projections are updated for all news.
items.implication: Monitor late for Moore/Spears; use updated ETR numbers.

items.text: NOT EXPECTED TO PLAY * Deebo Samuel
Projections are updated for all news: establishtherun.com hub. Show schedule for last-min livestream.
